## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one topic.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` for a user-visible change.
- [ ] README and README.zh.md reflect behavior or installation changes.
- [ ] No session logs, credentials, `.env` files, temporary folders, or personal paths are included.
- [ ] The plugin remains read-only and makes no third-party network calls.
- [ ] New visible text uses the locale service and both dictionaries.
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and agree to the Code of Conduct.
